sections.text_helper: Section 17.4.14 "TIM1 auto-reload register (TIM1_ARR)" in chapter 17 (Advanced-control timer (TIM1)), RM0490 Rev 6, page 428.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x2C
Reset value: 0xFFFF
Bits 15:0 ARR[15:0]: Auto-reload value
ARR is the value to be loaded in the actual auto-reload register.
Refer to the Section17.3.1: Time-base unit on page349 for more details about ARR update
and behavior.
The counter is blocked while the auto-reload value is null.
